Make sad dark trap music about a city that never answers, under violet streetlights. I want complete original lyrics.

Title: Rain A
Style: dark trap; sad, with a clear pulse and a slightly unwise finale

[Verse 1]
Streetlights blink like they know my name,
Every green signal turns back into rain.
I made one promise to make it through,
Then a city that never answers split the night in two.

[Chorus]
Oh, a city that never answers, you glorious mistake,
Rattle every window, make the cheap floor shake.
We had no good plan, so we shouted the tune—
Now the neighbors are dancing with a spoon and the moon.

[Verse 2]
The old beat stumbles, then finds its feet,
A beautiful error beneath the street.
A crooked rhythm crawls out of the wall,
We name it courage and dance through it all.

[Bridge]
Cut every light; let the low notes breathe.
Sometimes the truth is the sound underneath.

[Outro]
The signal bends, the screen goes black,
I laugh once softly and don't look back.
